__doc: HAND-WRITTEN NAMES FOR THE BLOCKS ON A PAGE.
The seed derives a label from each section's key, which gives 'Three' and
'Platforms' for /academics/teaching-learning/methodology/ - true to the key and
useless to a person. These are written from what the block actually renders, so
an editor can match a row to the part of the page they are looking at.
WARNING: A LABEL IS A NAME, NOT AN ADDRESS. The page finds its content by
`key`, never by this, so renaming here is safe and renaming a key is not.
Anything not listed keeps its derived label.
